expression: (1 - sum by (cluster, nodepool) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node"}, "nodepool", "$1", "instance", "aks-([a-z0-9]+)-.*")) / sum by (cluster, nodepool) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"}, "nodepool", "$1", "instance", "aks-([a-z0-9]+)-.*"))) * 100 > 85

annotations.description: Node pool {{ $labels.nodepool }} in cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} is using {{ $value | humanize }}% of its total memory (threshold 85%). Action: scale the node pool (increase max_count / node_count) or use a larger VM size.

expression: sum by (cluster, nodepool) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([a-z0-9]+)-.*")) / sum by (cluster, nodepool) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory"}, "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([a-z0-9]+)-.*")) * 100 > 90

annotations.description: Node pool {{ $labels.nodepool }} in cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} has {{ $value | humanize }}% of allocatable memory requested (threshold 90%). New pods may stay Pending. Action: scale the node pool (increase max_count / node_count) or use a larger VM size.
